title: datura longifolia
intro: Datura longifolia, commonly known as Devil's Trumpet or Moonflower, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Datura longifolia, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
